none: PAS NLM-CDEAB7: Roman Coin: Tetrarchic Nummus of Constantine I from Northorpe
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), dating to AD 307 (Reece Period 15). GENIO POPVLI ROMANI reverse. Mint of Trier. RIC VI, p. 210, no. 693b. Obverse description: Bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [FL] VAL CONSTANTINVS [N]O[...]. Reverse description: Genius standing left with patera; in field S [ -]. Reverse inscription: GEN[--]OMANI; spacing seems wide for this legend in full. Diameter: 25.3mm, Weight: 3.59gms, die axis: 6
